## Purpose

In the `align` mamba cache mode, a Mamba state can only be reused at block boundaries. Without checkpoints, the scheduler splits the last prefill chunk into two steps where the first step cuts at the block boundary and materialize the checkpoint there, and the second step performs an additional forward pass on the remaining context. body:
## Purpose

Add an opt-in path to the ROCm AITER FA backend that attends the extend tokens to the whole FP8 prefix with one `aiter.ops.mha.mha_batch_prefill_func` call. It replaces the loop that gathers 32k context tokens at a time into a workspace, runs dense FMHA on each chunk and merges every chunk output. At a 983k prefix that loop runs 30 times per full attention layer. The path is off by default. `VLLM_ROCM_AITER_PAGED_PREFIX=1` turns it on.

This PR is stacked on #53823, which adds prequantized FP8 QKV and the direct FP8 context gather. Until #53823 merges, the diff here also shows its 7 commits. The change in this PR is the last commit, 2a3fd9f874e5. Related to #57149.
